mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies and 50 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail under a Third Quarter moon. The International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, alternate-side winter street parking regulations will be in effect from November 20th through April 1st between 1:00 AM and 6:00 AM to keep roads clear for snow plows. Additionally, the City Water Utility is partnering with HydroCorp to conduct routine cross-connection control inspections to ensure municipal drinking water safety.
For local events, enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, or head to Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow for more live music. Hop Haus Brewing will also host trivia night later this week.
In police news, on Sunday morning officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped in the roadway and arrested a driver for an O W I first offence.
Over at Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM featuring Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough as today's flavor of the day.
